acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor for a luxury whole-home renovation in Los Angeles involves looking for experience with similar high-end projects, a strong portfolio, transparent communication, and a proven track record. Verify licenses, insurance, and ask for client references. Ensure the contractor understands local building codes and design trends unique to areas like Beverly Hills or Pasadena.
